subject: Requesting additional evaluation credits for secure deployment trial
messages:
From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@fortitudehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting additional evaluation credits for secure deployment trial

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Fortitude's infra and security teams liked the live latency profile and the VPC deployment options. We are moving into an internal 30-day Private VPC evaluation but the security team needs two things before we can sign off:

1) A short period extension on the trial so we can run encrypted-at-rest benchmarks and a SOC2-aligned evidence pull.
2) Promotional evaluation credits to cover the GPU-hours for the extended window (the PoC will spike tokens while we run full dataset tests).

Attached is our updated security questionnaire and a draft SOW outline. Can Redwood provide an additional 60,000 token-equivalent credits (or equivalent $ value) and extend the private trial to 60 days? If you need specific audit evidence from us, let me know who on your security team to speak with.

Thanks,
Emma Clark
Director, Platform Security
Fortitude Health
Attachments: Fortitude_SecQ_v2.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@fortitudehealth.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting additional evaluation credits for secure deployment trial

Emma —

Appreciate the detailed questionnaire and the SOW outline. We should be able to support an extended evaluation, but we'll need a quick security review and an approval on the promo credits. Looping in Mina (security) and Marissa (sales ops) to validate the evidence path and the credit amount.

Next steps I propose:
- Mina: can you confirm what evidence we require from Fortitude to meet our internal controls for a Private VPC POC?
- Marissa: can we provision a one-time promo package (60k tokens/30% off GPU bill cap) conditioned on receiving the SecQ and signed mutual NDA?
- Emma/Rajiv: if you can sign the mutual NDA, we can start provisioning within 48 hours of receipt.

I'll hold off on formal crediting until we confirm with security.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Requesting additional evaluation credits for secure deployment trial

Team —

Reviewed Fortitude's SecQ (thanks Emma). Summary and asks from security:

- Required evidence: SOC 2 or equivalent attestation (if available), network topology for the VPC PoC, list of test datasets with classification (PHI/PII), and a short access control matrix.
- Minimal gating: signed mutual NDA covering data handling and a short security addendum for Private deployment.
- Timeline: once we receive the NDA + access matrix, security can approve a one-time promotional allocation for POC purposes.

On credits: I recommend a conditional promo offering: 60,000-token equivalent credit + an additional 20,000 token contingent on passing the encrypted-at-rest benchmark within the first 30 days. We will require an audit log snapshot and a short playbook from Fortitude showing how keys are managed (KMS/HSM).

Please note: credits are tied to the Private VPC trial only and will expire if the PoC is terminated early. Marissa, please advise on the promo code format and SOW language for the credit terms.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@fortitudehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fortitudehealth.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting additional evaluation credits for secure deployment trial

Emma / Rajiv —

Good news: security has validated the evidence path and Sales Ops has approved a conditional promo. Summary of what Redwood will provide today:

- 60,000-token equivalent evaluation credit applied to your Private VPC PoC account (redeemable during a 60-day evaluation window).
- An additional 20,000-token contingency credit that will be unlocked after you submit the encrypted-at-rest benchmark and the key management playbook (per Mina's checklist).
- We will provision the Private VPC environment as soon as the signed mutual NDA is returned. I have attached a DocuSign link for a standard NDA and a short SOW addendum that describes the credit terms.

Action items for Fortitude:
- Sign the NDA: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcdef123456 (DocuSign).
- Return access matrix + key management doc to mina_haddad@redwood.com.
- Confirm a preferred start date for provisioning.

Marissa will follow up with the promo code and the internal HubSpot deal updates. Let me know if you need the credit amount expressed as an $ cap instead of token-equivalent.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: DocuSign_MutualNDA.pdf
